rationale: The Court will reverse on the ground that, read in statutory context and consistent with constitutional avoidance, "encourages or induces" is a solicitation/facilitation term of art targeting speech integral to unlawful conduct, so the statute is not facially overbroad under Williams. A Sotomayor dissent is likely to argue the narrowing construction amounts to rewriting and that chilling/notice concerns for immigration counseling warrant facial invalidation.
